enchantcalc.title: EnchantCalc
enchantcalc.button.use_owned.tooltip: Select every enchantment you have a book for, at the level of your best book. Curses are left out.
enchantcalc.button.clear.tooltip: Deselect every enchantment for this item
enchantcalc.button.show.tooltip: Plan the cheapest order to add enchantments
enchantcalc.mode.label: Mode: %s
enchantcalc.mode.levels.tooltip: Spend the fewest experience levels in total.
enchantcalc.mode.experience.tooltip: Spend the fewest experience points, assuming you collect the levels for each step separately. Cheap steps cost relatively little XP, so this can pick a different order than Fewest levels.
enchantcalc.mode.prior_work.tooltip: Keep the finished item's prior work penalty as low as possible, so later repairs and renames stay cheap. Among those orders, spends the fewest levels.
enchantcalc.empty.no_item: Put an item or enchanted book in the first anvil slot.
enchantcalc.empty.no_selection: Pick enchantments on the left to see the cheapest order.
enchantcalc.empty.no_selection_tab: Pick enchantments in the Enchants tab to see the cheapest order.
enchantcalc.enchant.book_cost: Costs %s per level from a book
enchantcalc.enchant.maxed: Already at max level on this item
enchantcalc.enchant.controls: Click: level up · Right-click: level down
enchantcalc.plan.stacked: Split the stack: anvils refuse stacked items
enchantcalc.plan.not_enough_levels: You have %s of the %s levels needed
enchantcalc.plan.xp_explained: %s experience points if you collect the levels for each step separately
enchantcalc.plan.too_expensive_explained: No order keeps every step below 40 levels, so a survival anvil will say "Too Expensive!". Remove an enchantment or pick a lower level.
enchantcalc.plan.missing_books_explained: Steps with an orange label need a book you don't have yet.
enchantcalc.plan.approximate: Large selection: this order is good, but may not be the cheapest.
enchantcalc.plan.prior_work_explained: After this plan the item has a prior work penalty of %s (anvil uses: %s). Every later anvil use on it costs that many extra levels.
enchantcalc.step.title: Step %s of %s
enchantcalc.step.too_expensive: Too Expensive! This step needs %s levels
enchantcalc.step.missing: You don't have this book yet
enchantcalc.step.ready: Both items are in place: take the result
enchantcalc.step.click: Click to highlight this step's items
